name: Uwajima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uwajima city emblem in green, red and blue: a green stylised figure with raised arms and a red disc, within a blue elliptical ring.
history: Municipal flag of Uwajima, a city in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 August 2005.

features.role: Uwajima city emblem — a green stylised figure with raised arms and a red disc, within a blue elliptical ring
